title: Characters and $II_1$-Factor Representations of Full Groups of Cantor Minimal Systems
summary: Let $(X,T)$ be a Cantor minimal system, and let $Γ$ denote either its associated topological full group or the full group of a Bratteli diagram associated with $(X,T)$. In this paper we describe the structure of indecomposable (extreme) characters and the associated $\textrm{II}_1$-factor representations for the group $Γ$ and its commutator subgroup $Γ'$.
